content:
- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 10–30% for high sentiment periods.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ 0.00) or volatile, model underestimates; increase forecast by 15–25% for negative sentiment.
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes in sentiment; cap forecast peaks at 2x recent high if sentiment > 0.67.
- Forecast mean reverts too slowly; apply 10–15% downward adjustment if 3+ consecutive days show low sentiment or price consolidation.
- For 30-day horizon, model often overestimates late-period outcomes (last 7–10 days); apply 10–20% downward correction if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- If sentiment history shows rapid reversal (e.g., from +0.67 to -0.33), model fails to adjust; apply 20–30% downward correction in next 5–7 days.
